تتداركوا (form VI)
# تَتَدَارَكُوا (tatadārakū) /ta.ta.daː.ra.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَدَارَكَ (tadāraka)
# تُتَدَارَكُوا (tutadārakū) /tu.ta.daː.ra.kuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَدَارَكَ (tadāraka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
